about_the_game:
About This Game

Papered is a fast-paced first-person arena hack-and-slash set inside a living sketchbook. In a world made entirely of paper and ink, drawings come to life — and you’re the one cutting them down.

Fight through chaotic arenas where enemies are printed, sketched, and assembled from paper. Slice them apart with scissors, tear through them with your blade, and splatter the world with ink as the battlefield slowly fills with color.

Every enemy you defeat bursts into paper fragments. Collect them, upgrade your weapons, and push your build further as the arena fills with increasingly dangerous foes. But beware: the world fights back. Enemies evolve, printers churn out reinforcements, and the chaos grows with every minute you survive.

The longer you last, the more intense the fight becomes.

Features

Fast First-Person Hack-and-Slash Combat
Cut, slice, and tear through waves of paper enemies with responsive melee combat and dynamic movement.

A Living Paper World
Everything is hand-drawn. Enemies crumple, rip, and explode into fragments as ink splatters across the black-and-white world.

Arena Survival Chaos
Face ever-increasing enemy waves in compact arenas where the action never slows down.

Collect and Upgrade
Gather paper fragments from fallen enemies to upgrade your weapons and abilities mid-run.

Evolving Enemies
Enemies grow stronger, adapt, and return with new armor and abilities as the battle escalates.

Every Run Is Different
Choose upgrades, experiment with builds, and see how long you can survive.

Enter the notebook.
Sharpen your scissors.
And start cutting.

How long can you survive the paper storm?
